dispatch.summary:
T474 meets all four acceptance items and is consistent with ARCH-3, ARCH-4, ARCH-21, ARCH-30, ARCH-32, ARCH-33 and review F4.

**Risk reasons checked first**
- The 394-line size comes from a move. A sorted line comparison shows the lines removed from facilities.ts match the new facility-model.ts exactly. The only additions are one doc-comment paragraph and a type-only import of FacilityPart and World. Function bodies, ladders, LEVEL_UPKEEP and the upkeep and capacity formulas are unchanged.
- The worker made no autopilot product decisions. Save schema, levels, Korean wording and event text are untouched.

**Acceptance**
- facilities.ts re-exports every model name it previously exported, so index.ts (`export * from './facilities'`) and existing consumers are unaffected. It keeps WORK_INFO, FACILITY_PART_LABEL, workDays, facilityWork, facilityUpkeep (through the T471 quotes and player-state leaves), nextWork, startFacilityWork and progressFacilityWorks.
- facility-model.ts has only a type import. source-graph's runtimeImports skips type-only edges, so the leaf test (closure equals the model file alone) holds.
- facilityImages.ts imports only the model at runtime. contracts is a type-only import.
- The new scripts/lib/facility-architecture.test.ts follows the existing closure pattern. It forbids facilities, world, season, calendar, events and quotes, and pins an exact allowlist. The shared architecture.test.ts is unchanged, as the task notes require.
- facility-model.test.ts uses minimal data. I hand-checked its expected values: 411.25 and 4411.25 for upkeep, 9600 and 1530450 for built units, and 2250, 5000, 27000, 40000 and 67500 for capacity during works. It also checks that the re-exports are the same bindings.
- The existing facilityScene.test.ts case that ignores construction targets is untouched. The new facilityImages.test.ts adds a direct check of the same thing.

**Interaction with the base**
- The base moved from a3b0cdd2 to 64783061 (T476, motion preference). That change touches none of these files.

**Test evidence**
- The worker reports typecheck, lint, format:check, the unit run on changed files (73 files, 562 tests, including facility-model, facilityImages, facility-architecture, facilityScene, theme and validate-presentation) and build all passing. That matches the ARCH-30 task tier.
- Integration consumers (finance, goals, investment, business, academy, training) and tests/e2e/facility-art.spec.ts are correctly left to the coordinator's batch gate.
- I did not re-run any tests in this read-only review.

**Scope**
- Other read-only consumers (validate-presentation, FacilityParts, outcome, and engine readers such as synergy and sponsors) still import facilities.ts. The task allows this: it says to update other consumers only when the boundary needs it, and the worker recorded these files under limits.

dispatch.summary: T476 (d0c9e731 vs a3b0cdd2) meets all four acceptance items. The reduced-motion query now lives only in apps/web/src/adapters/motionPreference.ts, with the old body moved over unchanged: it reads the browser on each call and returns false when the query is missing or throws. themeTransition.ts imports it directly. ui/motion.ts imports it and re-exports it under the same name, so CupHistory, AnimatedMoney, Dialog and play/exit/usePresence need no changes. No test mocks or spies on the ui/motion export, so the re-export is safe. The theme adapter no longer depends on ui/ or React. This follows ARCH-4 (adapters come before UI) and ARCH-32 (theme transition is a progressive browser adapter). The new guard, scripts/lib/motion-architecture.test.ts, uses the existing sourceGraph/dependencies/runtimeImports helpers, matches the process.cwd() pattern in architecture.test.ts (which is unchanged), and is picked up by the unit project through the scripts/**/*.test.ts glob. motionPreference.test.ts covers a matching query, a non-matching query, missing and throwing matchMedia, the exact query string, and reading only when called (a fresh module for each case). In themeTransition.test.ts every existing skip/commit/cancel/timing case is unchanged, and two new cases check that the transition still animates when matchMedia is missing or throws. The only risk reason given was 'autopilot decisions awaiting the owner'. I found no new design, timing, capability or product decision in the diff. The one open item (Pitch.tsx) is recorded under limits as a follow-up, not decided. Worker evidence: the targeted unit files (28 tests), unit --changed against the base (82 tests), typecheck, lint, format:check and build all passed. Spec lint was not run because the CLI was denied. The full unit, integration, contract and chromium runs are left to the coordinator's final gate.

dispatch.summary:
T476 완료: 테마 전환 어댑터가 더 이상 React UI 모듈에 의존하지 않습니다.

- 새 모듈 `apps/web/src/adapters/motionPreference.ts`가 `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` 조회를 맡습니다. `reducedMotion()` 본문은 이전 `ui/motion`의 것과 똑같습니다. 호출할 때마다 전역 `matchMedia`를 읽고, 없거나 예외가 나면 false를 돌려줍니다.
- `themeTransition.ts`는 이 모듈을 직접 가져옵니다. `ui/motion.ts`는 같은 함수를 같은 이름으로 다시 내보내므로 CupHistory, AnimatedMoney, Dialog와 play/exit/usePresence/fadeOutOnRemove는 import를 바꿀 필요가 없습니다.
- 테마 전환 어댑터의 런타임 의존은 이제 `themeTransition`과 `motionPreference` 두 파일뿐이고, `ui/` 파일도 react import도 없습니다. 애니메이션 시간(620ms), 스타일, 커밋/취소 로직은 바꾸지 않았습니다.

테스트:
- `motionPreference.test.ts`: 일치, 불일치, `matchMedia` 없음, 예외 발생의 네 경우와 정확한 쿼리 문자열, 그리고 import만으로는 브라우저를 읽지 않음을 확인합니다.
- `themeTransition.test.ts`: 기존 케이스는 그대로 두고, `matchMedia`가 없거나 예외를 내도 애니메이션이 실행되는 두 케이스를 추가했습니다.
- `scripts/lib/motion-architecture.test.ts`: 기존 source-graph 유틸로 위 의존 경계를 지킵니다. 공용 `architecture.test.ts`는 손대지 않았습니다. 옛 import를 잠시 되돌려 이 검사가 실제로 실패하는 것을 확인한 뒤 원래대로 돌려놓았습니다.

실행해서 통과한 검사: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline`, 영향받는 단위 테스트 5파일 28개, `vitest --project unit --changed a3b0cdd2` 13파일 82개, `typecheck`, `lint`, `format:check`, `build`, `git diff --check`. 새 검사 파일은 처음 `format:check`에서 걸려 prettier로 정리한 뒤 통과했습니다. 태스크 파일의 acceptance 네 항목을 [v]로 표시하고 result를 기록했습니다.

실행하지 않은 것:
- spec lint: 지정된 CLI 명령이 이 세션에서 거부되어 돌리지 못했습니다.
- 전체 unit/integration/contract 테스트, `validate:catalogs`, Chromium 브라우저 여정(테마 전환·프레젠테이션 설정 포함)은 호스트의 최종 관문으로 넘겼습니다.

남은 점: `apps/web/src/ui/Pitch.tsx:299`가 아직 같은 쿼리를 직접 호출합니다. 이 태스크의 수정 범위와 acceptance 밖이라 그대로 두었고, 나중에 이 어댑터를 쓰도록 바꿀 수 있습니다.

커밋, push, 제출은 하지 않았습니다.

dispatch.summary:
T473 is done: host.ts, protocol.ts and slots.ts no longer import any ui/ module. The task checks passed, but I ran no integration, browser or full suite; those go to your final gate.

**What moved**
- `apps/web/src/runtime/playerTallies.ts` now owns the tally code and its types (perOwnMatches, cardCounts, leagueReds, appearanceCounts, tallies, and the Cards/Appearances/PlayerTally/Tallies types). The code moved unchanged; `tallies` now asks only for the four World fields it reads.
- `apps/web/src/presentation/competitionLabels.ts` owns kindLabel, divisionName and competitionLabel.
- `apps/web/src/presentation/crests.ts` owns Crest, crestMap, crestOf and the fallback crest, using the existing engine identity-legacy code.
- The old UI files (discipline, playerAnalysis, careerRecords, league, format, crests) re-export the old names and keep only their UI helpers.
- host.ts and slots.ts import the new owners directly. protocol.ts takes Tallies from playerTallies, and its transferOffers/sponsorSlots import is now type-only. I'm not claiming any speedup from that.

**One small difference:** there were two copies of `divisionName`, in ui/league and ui/careerRecords. They gave the same label for every catalog country. For an unknown country code the careerRecords copy threw, while the league copy returned "아마추어 리그". The single shared version keeps the league behaviour. Every caller of the old careerRecords copy passes the own club's country, which is always in the catalog.

**Tests added**
- `apps/web/src/runtime/playerTallies.test.ts` uses small hand-built data, no generated world. It checks appearances, substitutes, cards, that only league reds count, and season heat. It also checks that the cached result is reused across revisions and rebuilt after a reload, a new own match and a season change.
- `scripts/lib/architecture.test.ts` now checks host, protocol and slots for direct ui/ imports (type-only ones included) and for ui/, React or Zustand anywhere they reach at runtime. Engine use in host is still allowed. The three shared modules may only reach contracts, catalogs and leaf engine modules, not world/season/match code. I put ui/ imports back into protocol.ts and slots.ts temporarily and the guard failed on both, then restored them.

**Checks run**
- `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run lint` and `git diff --check` passed.
- `pnpm run format:check` failed once on discipline.ts; I fixed it with prettier and the check then passed.
- Unit tests changed since a3b0cdd2: 26 files, 187 tests passed. The affected unit files run directly: 9 files, 57 tests passed.
- `pnpm run build` passed.

**Left for your final gate:** `pnpm run test:unit`, `pnpm run test:integration`, `pnpm run test:contract`, `pnpm run validate:catalogs`, `pnpm run build` and `PREVIEW_BUILD=1 pnpm exec playwright test --project=chromium`. The integration tier covers host.test, host.archive.test, client.test, next-event.test, personCareer.test and ui/league.test. The browser run includes `tests/e2e/club-identity-preparation.spec.ts`, which imports competitionLabel through ui/format.

Spec lint through the haeram CLI was blocked by the sandbox, so it did not run. All edits stay within the task's file list plus the task's own acceptance/result. I did not touch T469 files or make any commits. T475 has not been started.
